name: get_project_context
description: Read model units, input hash, case IDs and supported analysis capabilities. Does not run analysis.

name: inspect_model
description: Read current Model Check issues, without running a solver or repairing the model.

name: select_entities
description: Highlight one existing node or member in the shared view. Changes selection only.

name: validate_analysis
description: Validate an existing case and compute route for the current model hash. Does not start a job.

name: plan_analysis
description: Plan an existing analysis case. Review route, qualification and blocking conditions before starting.

name: start_analysis
description: Start analysis of the current existing case and publish its results to the UI. Returns a job ID. Reuse requestId to avoid duplicate execution.

name: get_analysis_status
description: Read execution status, errors, provenance and whether the model changed since this job started.

name: get_result_slice
description: Read a bounded path from an existing completed job. Default is summary. Preserves qualification and flags stale results; does not rerun analysis.

name: cancel_analysis
description: Request cancellation of one analysis job started by this page session. Completed results are retained.

name: get_workflow_context
description: Read current input identity, supported workflow and completed analysis records; never runs a solver.

name: get_design_context
description: Read a paginated typed model channel and missing input categories without solving.

name: preview_design_changes
description: Preview bounded typed design changes using M2. Does not apply changes or solve.

name: get_design_changes
description: Read all preview changes by page before applying a stored handle.

name: apply_design_changes
description: Apply a previously previewed change handle atomically. Invalidates old results; does not run analysis.

name: preview_analysis_case
description: Preview creation or update of one typed elastic case.

name: apply_analysis_case
description: Apply a previously previewed case-only handle.

name: plan_elastic_workflow
description: Plan existing elastic cases in dependency order; no analysis.

name: start_elastic_workflow
description: Start a stored elastic workflow plan; return a handle immediately. Poll workflow status.

name: get_elastic_workflow
description: Read an existing workflow and source run IDs; never runs analysis.

name: cancel_elastic_workflow
description: Cancel a session workflow and skip remaining cases.

name: plan_design_review
description: Plan preliminary design from exact completed static/Direct combination records.

name: start_design_review
description: Calculate and record preliminary design from a stored plan; does not rerun analysis.

name: get_design_result
description: Read summary or paginated checks/sources/rules from a stored design record.

name: plan_report_export
description: Plan report creation from a current design record. Does not create a report or export files.

name: start_report_export
description: Create immutable HTML/JSON/CSV report artifacts in session; no external publication or automatic PDF.

name: get_report_artifact
description: Read a bounded text chunk of an existing HTML/JSON/CSV artifact; no file paths accepted.

name: set_workspace_view
description: Switch the shared workspace view only; does not calculate or edit the model.
